# Conservation Mart

> B2B wholesale marketplace specializing in energy efficiency, water conservation, and home safety products for bulk purchasing.

Conservation Mart offers a curated catalog of EPA-certified and industry-leading conservation kits and devices. The platform serves businesses and organizations seeking to implement energy-saving, water-saving, and safety solutions at scale, with a focus on brands like Kidde, BRK Electronics, Emporia, and Conserve Smart.

## Key Topics

- Energy Conservation
- Water Conservation
- Weatherization
- Carbon Monoxide Detectors
- Smart Power Strips
- Energy Monitors
- Smart Thermostats
- Smoke & Fire Detectors
- B2B Bulk Purchasing
- EPA WaterSense
- Energy Star
- Motion-Sensor Devices
- Electric Vehicle Chargers
- Educational Conservation
- Home Efficiency
